about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/check: edits of the package's source that some test, law or example must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants check; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it and how to add a mutant. Seeded from the test-speed plan (wf10, 2026-11-08) and the units' verify mutants.

mutants.name: L8-C1-index-borrow-moves-container
mutants.rule: An index borrow cannot escape into an earlier keeper by moving its entire container implicitly.

mutants.name: L8-C1-diagnostic-at-take
mutants.from: w.refuse(i, at, "a resource is taken while lent"
mutants.to: w.refuse(i, w.vars[i].v.id, "a resource is taken while lent"
mutants.rule: The early-take diagnostic points at the take, not the root declaration.

mutants.name: L8-C1-named-callback-loses-keeper
mutants.rule: A named callback carries its existing loans into the Set that keeps it.

mutants.name: L8-C1-callable-field-erases-loan
mutants.rule: Selecting a callable field does not erase its root lifetime.

mutants.name: L8-C1-keeper-order
mutants.rule: A keeper must release before the resource root.

mutants.name: L8-C1-incoming-return-bound
mutants.from: return lendPoint{scope: w.lendFrame, order: -1, v: v}
mutants.rule: An incoming borrow lasts until this frame returns, not until an invented local release.

mutants.name: L8-C1-field-release-order
mutants.rule: A literal's fields release in reverse declaration order, not evaluation order.

mutants.name: L8-C1-root-inheritance
mutants.rule: An iteration binding keeps its container's root owner.

mutants.name: L8-C1-take-while-lent
mutants.rule: A root cannot be taken while its keeper may still run.

mutants.name: rpc-c2 wire keys keep their case
mutants.rule: stdlib.md, json 1 (owner q81; types.md Codecs 2, H3): a record's keys are its field names with the leading capitals lowered, Option's value as value, which Effect's Schemas read.

mutants.name: wire-initialism-last-capital
mutants.from: n-- // the run's last capital starts the next word
mutants.rule: types.md Codecs 2: a capital run that a lower-case letter follows keeps its last capital (HTTPStatus as httpStatus).

mutants.name: wire-initialism-whole-run
mutants.rule: types.md Codecs 2: the whole leading initialism is lowered (ID as id, URL as url).

mutants.name: wire-key-clash
mutants.to: if other, ok := keys[k]; ok && false {
mutants.rule: types.md Codecs 2: a record whose fields share a wire key has no wire form; the S108 names both fields and the key.

mutants.name: gocopy-ergo-use
mutants.rule: interop.md Lowering 3 (H5): only a let that is also an Ergo value is a copy; a Go-only let is Go's map, and its writing method is no error.

mutants.name: gocopy-writes
mutants.rule: interop.md Lowering 3 (H5): a Go method with a result reads; only one with no result can only write the copy.

mutants.name: x2-pred-purity-skipped
mutants.rule: types.md Laws 13: an invariant law's predicate is pure (an empty footprint).

mutants.name: x2-pred-error-row-admitted
mutants.rule: types.md Laws 13: an invariant law's predicate has no error row.

mutants.name: x2-pred-param-type-admitted
mutants.rule: types.md Laws 13: an invariant law's predicate takes the machine's state.

mutants.name: c4-script-borrow-admitted
mutants.origin: wf10 L8 C4 (#197; batch-15 fix-r2 Script note)
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Testing 7: a Script's record of calls keeps each argument past the call, so an operation that takes a borrow (*T) makes no Script.

mutants.name: c4-script-resource-admitted
mutants.origin: wf10 L8 C4 (#197; batch-15 fix-r2 Script note)
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Testing 7, resources Lending: an operation that takes a value holding a resource makes no Script; the record would be a second owner.

mutants.name: c4-script-kept-unchecked
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Testing 7: every admitted Script's capability is checked for a resource parameter at its type argument.
